name: Blob Arena
tagline: Snack, split, and swallow the room.
description: Steer a hungry blob around one shared arena. Eat snacks to grow, swallow smaller rivals, or split in two for a risky lunge. Get swallowed? Return in three seconds. Your mass at the end of each 90-second round becomes points. Biggest total after three rounds wins.
howToPlay: Drag the steering pad. Eat little snacks to grow; bigger blobs move slower.
Swallow smaller rivals. Tap SPLIT to lunge, but each half is easier to eat.
Mass left when the 90-second clock ends scores. Biggest total after three rounds wins.
